findings.body: `repo.default_config(top)` runs `git fetch origin` (src/forge/repo.py:160-164). Because this new call runs whenever the cached default branch has a Dockerfile, `forge next` now fails when origin is unavailable, even if the cached branch contains everything needed to show the platform reminder. It can also refresh the branch midway through a report that has already read other state. Read `forge.toml` from the same last-fetched ref used for the Dockerfile and brief.
findings.title: Use the last-fetched branch for the demo reminder
